answer.imageToCode: Feasible as evidence-guided reconstruction with explicit uncertainty, not guaranteed inverse recovery of hidden mathematical intent.
answer.preciseControl: Yes for appearance, object identity, labels and bounded edits; mathematical precision additionally requires explicit semantic geometry and source-backed constraints. Raw SVG alone does not provide mathematical correctness.
answer.recommended: Reuse existing TypeScript scene/SVG path; add typed semantic IR and a small constructive geometry dependency graph before adopting a general optimizer.
answer.limit: A clean, role-consistent drawing does not prove faithful recovery. Unknown values and obscured topology remain unknown until new evidence or explicit approximation authorization.

boundaries.source: Immutable original PDF/page/crop hashes; original comparison remains available in review output.
boundaries.recognition: Jev exact1.14 performs bounded source/research triage, routing and presence plus Box region proposals only. Experimental singlebox/no-notfound limitation requires paired presence handling; these constraints are inherited from parent, not provider-tested here.
boundaries.synthesis: GPT turns admitted evidence and source mathematical text into typed proposals; uncertain topology/content escalates. Models do not execute arbitrary generated code or silently add facts.
boundaries.math: Source-asserted constraints are distinct from visually inferred shape and authorized illustrative approximation. Constructive geometry evaluates a DAG; general constraint solving is an adapter with residual/branch checks.
boundaries.presentation: Diagram styles and anchored labels separate from math. Options/proof boxes are layout objects, with text/math payloads separate from diagram geometry.
boundaries.renderer: Receives validated, finite, fully resolved drawing coordinates and escaped label payloads; returns SVG, optional raster, and hashes. No OCR/model calls, source edits, answer solving or packaging.
boundaries.nativeOwner: Native Codex owns orchestration, tools, sessions and bounded delegation; deterministic TypeScript owns schema, geometry and asset checks.

editFlow: Classify natural-language request as presentation, geometry-layout, content-parameter or evidence-correction.
Resolve explicit object IDs against a frozen baseRevision; propose a bounded typed patch with allowed targets, max operation count and preserved constraint IDs.
Validate references, authority and parameter bounds. Reject unknown source values, implicit source-content changes, stale revisions and undeclared targets.
Apply patch to a new IR revision; evaluate geometry DAG. For simultaneous constraints, use bounded solver with fixed branch/initial state and fail closed on unsatisfied or degenerate geometry.
Recompute anchored labels, arcs, dependent annotations and shared expression references. Collision resolution moves presentation only within declared limits.
Render with pinned viewport, fonts and renderer; produce semantic object diff, parameter diff, geometric residuals and visual original/restored comparison.

Record verification separately from visual evaluation. User review handles unresolved evidence or semantic changes; progressively reduce routine gates only after verified performance. No synthesized AcceptanceDecision.

numericSynchronization.architecture: A canonical parameter/expression ID is shared by problem text/math, diagram dimensions and labels. Never infer linkage by matching identical rendered strings.
numericSynchronization.sourceRestoration: Original values remain frozen. A changed numeric problem is a separate explicit content-edit revision, preserving the restoration baseline.
numericSynchronization.unknown: Unknown/illegible value cannot enter an executable constraint or expression evaluation. Render explicit unresolved state or keep original comparison.
numericSynchronization.future: Code-level text/math representations can later feed native-editable export; document formatting/export remains out of scope.

reviewPolicy.studentWriting: Excluded only in restored output; retained in original evidence
reviewPolicy.boxes: Options/proof boxes are layout objects, not geometry figures
reviewPolicy.cleanerLayout: Permitted as presentation without changing admitted mathematical content

userChoices.question: For code-level review, should the first deliverable be static original/restored comparison plus natural-language revisions, or an interactive browser with draggable objects?
userChoices.impact: Static fits existing SVG path; immediate interactive dragging makes JSXGraph adapter evaluation material.

userChoices.question: Should diagram preview assets prioritize portable identical glyph appearance across computers, or selectable text inside SVG? The semantic text remains editable in the IR in either case.
userChoices.recommended: Portable appearance with source text preserved in IR
userChoices.impact: Outlined-glyph rendering requires a font/shaping asset adapter and hashes; SVG text needs pinned fonts at viewing time. This choice concerns diagram labels only; future native document text/math remains separate.

userChoices.question: Should the first IR include dormant shared parameter/expression IDs for future text/math synchronization, or add bindings only after restoration pilots?
userChoices.recommended: Include dormant IDs now, keep source values frozen
userChoices.impact: Early IDs reduce later migration; later binding yields a smaller initial schema but needs a migration.
